snippets.react:
import { Disclosure, Text, Stack } from '@design-schema/react';

const panel = (
  <Text>
    You keep access until the end of the current billing period. Your data is kept for 30 days after that, then
    deleted.
  </Text>
);

<Stack gap="none">
  <Disclosure summary="What happens if I cancel?" headingLevel="3">{panel}</Disclosure>
  <Disclosure summary="Can I change plans later?" headingLevel="3">
    <Text>Yes. Changes take effect at the next billing date.</Text>
  </Disclosure>
  <Disclosure summary="Do you offer refunds?" headingLevel="3">
    <Text>Within 14 days of a charge, in full.</Text>
  </Disclosure>
</Stack>
snippets.lit:

  <ds-disclosure summary="Do you offer refunds?" heading-level="3">
    <ds-text>Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase.</ds-text>
  </ds-disclosure>
  <ds-disclosure summary="What happens if I cancel?" heading-level="3">
    <ds-text>Your workspace becomes read-only at the end of the billing period.</ds-text>
  </ds-disclosure>
</ds-stack>
